item.title: Local reaction to closure of Northern Standard
item.description: There has been reaction locally to the closure of the Northern Standard. The paper published its last edition today after nearly 200 years in circulation. The Northern Standard has been the longest established newspaper circulating in County Monaghan, the first issue was published back in January 10th, 1839. item.title: Monaghan retailer says Christmas allows people to rest
item.description: A Monaghan business woman says Christmas should be about family, faith and kindness. Helen Drumm spoke on the Joe Finnegan show today about her belief that peace, love and taking time to be patient with one another should be people's focus over the Christmas season. She says Christmas offers people a break from everyday daily life, and families can come together and spend quality time. item.title: Green light for 78 new homes in Virginia
item.description: 78 new homes has been given the green light by Cavan County Council in Virginia. Along with the dwellings a single storey creche to complete the existing residential development known as The Drumlins was also approved. The Drumlins development was previously approved planning permission and will now allow the removal of 19 existing partially constructed dwellings. item.title: N2 remains closed following fatal collision
item.description: The N2 remains closed this evening following a fatal collision that occurred near Castleblayney this morning. Gardaí are appealing for witnesses to the fatal road traffic collision that happened at 8am along the route this morning. Gardaí and emergency services were alerted to a collision involving a HGV and a car on the N2 at Mullaghnee, Annalitten, near Broomfield. item.title: Update: N3 reopens near Virginia following collision
item.description: The N3 has been closed in Co Cavan this evening following a collision. The collision has occurred on the N3 south of Virginia on the Dublin side of the Tirlan facility. The road is closed in both directions while emergency services deal with the incident. Advertisement It’s not known at present how many vehicles are involved or if they are injuries. Diversions will be put in place but motorists are being advised to avoid the area if possible.

item.title: N2 near Castleblayney set to remain closed tonight
item.description: The N2 is set to remain closed tonight following a fatal collision today in Co Monaghan. A man aged in his 50 was arrested in relation to the crash and remains detained in Garda custody under section 4 of the Criminal Justice Act, 1984. Gardai say the N2 remains closed as forensic investigations continue at the scene and diversions remain in place.
